reply_text:
I told Pree in a thread reply to her message in #central-random that the ticket is #8841.

Tobias posted it in that same channel yesterday (Oct 13, 9:27): West yard Door 2 at the Plains depots keeps double-booking when flatbeds check in early at the kiosk, and he flagged it on #8841 for support. I also warned her not to mix it up with #88412, an older ticket for Tansleigh Packaging, a different account.

His message doesn't actually say "Marrow Fieldworks". I matched it from context: he was replying about the dealer account, and a January handoff note calls Marrow Fieldworks the dealer account.

I only read channels Pree belongs to and public files, so nothing she couldn't see herself went into the answer.
